turns.question: Of the partner outreach messages we sent from 1 to 3 October 2026, what share got an answer within 12 hours?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for replies within 12 hours; the closest are reply rate (share of outreach messages that got a reply at any time, one definition of reply rate and response rate), messages replied and messages sent. For messages sent 1 to 3 October 2026 the reply rate is 66.7 % (4 replied of 6 sent), counting replies whenever they arrived, not only within 12 hours. Late: partner_outreach.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
